passport.name: Passport
passport.how_to_obtain: Apply or renew at your passport office. Keep at least 2 years of validity beyond your planned start date.
passport.tips: Scan the photo page in colour (300 dpi PDF). Many portals reject passports expiring within 6-18 months of arrival.

national_id.name: National ID card
national_id.how_to_obtain: Civil registry office. Scan both sides.

passport_photo.name: Passport-style photo
passport_photo.how_to_obtain: Any photo studio. Ask for a digital copy (white background, 35x45 mm).
passport_photo.tips: Keep a JPG under 1 MB; several portals have strict size limits.

birth_certificate.name: Birth certificate (with certified translation)
birth_certificate.how_to_obtain: Civil registry office. Get a certified English translation if it is not in English.

proof_of_residence.name: Proof of residence
proof_of_residence.how_to_obtain: Residence certificate from your local authority, or a recent utility bill / bank statement in your name.

family_documents.name: Family relationship documents
family_documents.how_to_obtain: Civil registry (family record / household register). Usually needs apostille or consular legalization.

degree_certificate.name: Degree certificate / diploma
degree_certificate.how_to_obtain: University registrar. If you have not graduated yet, ask for an official 'expected graduation' letter.
degree_certificate.tips: Order several stamped English copies at once; certified copies are reused across applications.

transcript.name: Official academic transcript (with grading scale)
transcript.how_to_obtain: University registrar. Ask for an English version that includes the grading scale and your rank if available.

secondary_certificate.name: Secondary / high-school certificate
secondary_certificate.how_to_obtain: School or Ministry of Education. Needed mainly for Bachelor applications.

course_descriptions.name: Course descriptions / syllabus
course_descriptions.how_to_obtain: Your department office or the university catalogue (stamped copy).

class_rank_certificate.name: Class rank / GPA certificate
class_rank_certificate.how_to_obtain: Registrar or dean's office: an official letter stating your rank or percentile.

credential_evaluation.name: Credential recognition / evaluation
credential_evaluation.how_to_obtain: Depends on the destination: CIMEA or Declaration of Value (Italy), nostrification (Czech Republic), uni-assist VPD (Germany), NEDA grade equivalence (Spain). See `cli.py credentials`.

thesis_abstract.name: Thesis abstract
thesis_abstract.how_to_obtain: Write a 1-page abstract of your graduation project or thesis.

english_test.name: English test result (IELTS / TOEFL / Duolingo / PTE)
english_test.how_to_obtain: Book IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT 6-8 weeks ahead; results arrive in 3-13 days. Results are valid for 2 years.
english_test.tips: Check each program's minimum sub-score (e.g. no band below 6.0), not only the overall score.

english_moi_letter.name: English medium-of-instruction letter
english_moi_letter.how_to_obtain: Registrar letter confirming your degree was taught in English. Some programs accept it instead of IELTS/TOEFL.

other_language_test.name: Other language certificate (German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese...)
other_language_test.how_to_obtain: Goethe/TestDaF (German), DELF/DALF (French), DELE (Spanish), JLPT (Japanese), TOPIK (Korean), HSK (Chinese).

standardized_test.name: GRE / GMAT / SAT score
standardized_test.how_to_obtain: Book with ETS (GRE) or GMAC (GMAT) and allow 1-3 months of preparation.

employment_certificate.name: Employment certificate (proof of work experience)
employment_certificate.how_to_obtain: HR letter on company letterhead with start/end dates, job title, full-time hours per week, signature and stamp.
employment_certificate.tips: Chevening, DAAD and SI count hours: ask HR to state weekly hours explicitly.

volunteer_certificate.name: Volunteer / internship certificates
volunteer_certificate.how_to_obtain: Letters from the organizations you volunteered or interned with (dates, role, hours).

lor_academic.name: Academic recommendation letter
lor_academic.how_to_obtain: Ask professors who supervised your project or taught your core courses. Give them a brag sheet and at least 4 weeks.
lor_academic.tips: Record each referee in documents.json (count_ready = letters you can rely on).

lor_professional.name: Professional / employer recommendation letter
lor_professional.how_to_obtain: Ask your direct manager. Official letterhead, signature, stamp and contact details.

lor_leadership.name: Leadership / character reference
lor_leadership.how_to_obtain: Someone who has seen you lead: NGO director, community leader, club advisor.

lor_any.name: Recommendation letters (academic or professional)
lor_any.how_to_obtain: Any mix of academic and professional referees. Record them as lor_academic / lor_professional in documents.json.

cv.name: CV / résumé
cv.how_to_obtain: Write a 1-2 page academic CV (education, experience, research, leadership, skills). See data/document_templates.json.

cv_europass.name: CV in Europass format
cv_europass.how_to_obtain: Convert your CV at europass.europa.eu (free). DAAD requires it hand-signed with exact employment dates.

writing_sample.name: Writing sample
writing_sample.how_to_obtain: A paper, thesis chapter or report you wrote (usually 10-20 pages).

awards_certificates.name: Awards, course & training certificates
awards_certificates.how_to_obtain: Collect PDFs of awards, online courses, professional certificates and competition results.

income_documents.name: Family income & asset documents
income_documents.how_to_obtain: Income statements, tax records and asset declarations. Italian DSU needs them legalized by the Italian consulate (ISEE parificato).

medical_certificate.name: Medical certificate / health examination
medical_certificate.how_to_obtain: Use the program's own form when one exists (CSC, MEXT, Stipendium Hungaricum). Includes blood tests / X-ray for some programs.
medical_certificate.tips: Usually must be issued within 6 months of the deadline: do it late in the process.

police_clearance.name: Police clearance certificate
police_clearance.how_to_obtain: Ministry of Interior / police authority. Often needs legalization.
police_clearance.tips: Usually valid for 3-6 months: request it close to the deadline.

motivation_letter.name: Motivation letter / statement of purpose
motivation_letter.how_to_obtain: Draft in letters/ using the template. Tailor every letter to the program; never reuse one unchanged.

personal_statement.name: Personal statement
personal_statement.how_to_obtain: Draft in letters/: who you are, what drives you, evidence from your story bank.

essay.name: Scholarship essays
essay.how_to_obtain: One file per essay in essays/. Use STAR stories from profile/story_bank.md and respect the word limit.

study_plan.name: Study plan / study objectives
study_plan.how_to_obtain: Draft in letters/: courses, modules, thesis focus and how they lead to your career goal.

research_proposal.name: Research proposal
research_proposal.how_to_obtain: Draft in letters/ using the research proposal framework (problem, gap, questions, method, timeline). Share with your prospective supervisor.

development_impact_plan.name: Development impact / give-back statement
development_impact_plan.how_to_obtain: Draft in letters/: the concrete problem at home you will work on after graduating, and how.

cv_template.name: CV in the program's mandatory template
cv_template.how_to_obtain: Download the template from the official site (e.g. SI CV template, Canadian Common CV) and transfer your CV into it.

portfolio.name: Portfolio / pre-assignment
portfolio.how_to_obtain: Program-specific (design, architecture, business). Check the program page for the brief.

application_form.name: Scholarship application form
application_form.how_to_obtain: Create an account on the official portal early and fill the form section by section.

university_choices.name: Chosen university programs
university_choices.how_to_obtain: Research and shortlist programs that fit your goal; record them in forms/university_choices.md.

university_application.name: Application to the host university program
university_application.how_to_obtain: Many scholarships require you to apply to the university first (or at the same time). Check its own deadline.

signed_declaration.name: Signed declarations / applicant agreement
signed_declaration.how_to_obtain: Download from the portal, sign and scan.

online_test.name: Online test / screening exam
online_test.how_to_obtain: Program-run aptitude or technical test. Prepare with past materials if available.

admission_letter.name: University offer / admission letter
admission_letter.how_to_obtain: Issued by the university after you apply. Track conditions you must meet to make it unconditional.

supervisor_acceptance.name: Supervisor acceptance / invitation letter
supervisor_acceptance.how_to_obtain: Email prospective supervisors early (see `cli.py email-professor`). Allow several rounds of follow-up.

host_professor_cv.name: Short CV of the host professor
host_professor_cv.how_to_obtain: Ask your confirmed supervisor for a 1-2 page CV.

nomination_letter.name: Nomination / endorsement
nomination_letter.how_to_obtain: Issued by the nominating body (university, embassy or home-country sending partner). Find its internal deadline, which is earlier than the main one.
